personality_one_liner: A local-first medicine discovery and ordering platform connecting customers with nearby pharmacies with clean teal and white trust aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with iOS-native padding and fixed bottom action bars.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky search bars, tab bars, and bottom sheet headers.
dont's: Never apply blur to dense lists or form fields.

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Seamless phone/email login and welcoming patients to local pharmacy delivery.
screens.layout: FullScreen swipe slides with smooth indicators, followed by clean phone/email auth card with Apple/Google SSO placeholders.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary local discovery hub showing nearby pharmacies, urgent OTC items, and prescription upload banner.

states.empty: No pharmacies found in your selected area.
states.error: Unable to fetch location. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky header with location selector and search bar, prescription upload banner card, horizontal category chips, nearby pharmacy cards with stock status, and trending medicines list.

screens.name: Categories
screens.purpose: Browse medicines and healthcare essentials organized by therapeutic categories.
screens.layout: Grid of category cards with teal icon containers and item counts, searchable instant filter.

screens.name: Orders
screens.purpose: Track active deliveries and view past medicine order history with detailed timelines.

states.empty: No orders placed yet. Start by ordering required medicines.

screens.layout: Segmented control for Active vs Past orders, order status cards with live driver tracking link, and reorder button.

screens.name: Offers
screens.purpose: Discover healthcare discounts, pharmacy cashback codes, and wellness deals.
screens.layout: Featured promo banner card, coupon code list with copy actions, and applicable pharmacy tags.

screens.name: Account
screens.purpose: Manage profile details, delivery addresses, saved prescriptions, and customer support.

states.empty: Please sign in to view account details.

screens.layout: User profile card at top, settings list rows with icons (Addresses, Prescriptions, Payments, Support, Logout).

pharmacy_storefront.alt: Local pharmacy storefront with shelves of medicines

prescription_banner.alt: Doctor writing prescription with pills nearby

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all screens respect safe area boundaries, use teal/green primary actions (#0D9488), dark navy text (#0B2545), and white card backgrounds. Make sure real logo fetching or icon containers are used for pharmacies. Include sticky bottom CTAs on checkout and cart screens.
